sights.n: Asahiyama Memorial Park (旭山記念公園)
sights.address: Moiwa-shita / Asahigaoka, Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A hillside park between Mt Moiwa and Maruyama built for Sapporo's centenary — its lookout at 137.5 m takes in the whole grid of the city and is one of Sapporo's classic free night-view spots.

sights.n: Sapporo Shiryōkan — former Sapporo Court of Appeals (札幌市資料館)
sights.address: Ōdōri Nishi 13-chōme, Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The 1926 sandstone Court of Appeals at the west end of Ōdōri Park, its façade carved with the blindfolded scales of justice — now a free city museum with a preserved courtroom and the Ōta Shinkichi manga gallery.

sights.n: Kotoni Tondenhei Village Barracks Site (琴似屯田兵村兵屋跡)
sights.w: A surviving 1874 farmer-soldier (tondenhei) house of the first militia village that settled Sapporo — a National Historic Site, restored with its earthen-floor kitchen and open hearth.
